user.title: SNMP Storage Monitor
user.description: Set the SNMP host, port and protocol version.

credentials.title: SNMP credentials
credentials.description: Enter the credentials. For SNMP v1 or v2c, traffic is unencrypted. <details><summary>Security details</summary>SNMP traffic between Home Assistant and the target is plain text. It exposes the community string, OIDs and values. Devices on the subnet, including switches and firewalls, may be able to read this traffic. Use SNMPv3 whenever possible.</details>

select.title: Select sensors
select.description: Select physical memory and disk metrics. Select at least one sensor.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the SNMP agent. Check host, port, version and credentials.
error.storage_permission: The SNMP agent responds to sysName, but access to hrStorageDescr is denied. Grant read access to the HOST-RESOURCES-MIB storage table.
error.snmp_probe_failed: SNMP test failed: neither sysName nor hrStorageDescr returned readable data. Check connectivity, SNMP version, credentials and read permissions.
